def training_flops(n_params: int, n_tokens: int) -> float:
    # C ~= 6 * N * D
    return 6 * n_params * n_tokens

# A 7B-parameter model trained on 2T tokens
flops = training_flops(n_params=7e9, n_tokens=2e12)
print(f"{flops:.2e} FLOPs")  # ~8.4e22 FLOPs
caption: 6x parameters x tokens -- a rough but planning-grade compute estimate.

def gpu_hours(total_flops, peak_flops_per_sec, mfu):
    achieved = peak_flops_per_sec * mfu
    return (total_flops / achieved) / 3600

# One H100, ~989 TFLOPs/s bf16 peak, 40% MFU
hours = gpu_hours(8.4e22, 989e12, mfu=0.40)
print(f"{hours:.0f} GPU-hours on a single H100")
caption: MFU -- the fraction of peak hardware you actually realize -- decides your real cost.
